You don’t go to the surgeon first. You go to the doctor.

The doctor doesn’t walk in selling knee surgery. He examines you. He asks questions. He runs the tests. And then he tells you what’s actually wrong and exactly which specialist you need — if you need one at all.

Your business works the same way. But nobody’s examining it.

Every marketing company, SEO shop, and software rep is a specialist. They only know how to fix the one thing they sell. So they diagnose you with whatever they’ve got — and you leave with a bill instead of an answer.

KnoMor is the exam. We ask the questions, run the tests, and hand you the results. If you need a specialist, the report tells you which one. If you don’t, it tells you that too.

$149 is the visit. Not the surgery.

Hey — I’m Rob. I’m going to be the one on the other end of the phone if you book a KnoMor call, so I figured you should hear this from me.

I’ve spent fifteen-plus years building tools for contractors. And the thing I kept running into wasn’t that guys had bad software. It was that they’d been sold software before anybody asked how their business actually works.

Think about it like a doctor. You don’t walk into a surgeon’s office and get surgery. You get examined first. Somebody asks questions, runs tests, and then tells you what you need. Nobody does that for your business. Every rep who calls you is a specialist selling one fix.

So that’s what KnoMor is. It’s the exam. You pay $149. We get on the phone for about forty-five minutes. I ask you a lot of questions — how you get jobs, how you quote them, what happens when you miss a call, who’s taking work from you. Everything gets recorded and turned into an interactive report. Four sections. Where you show up, where your time goes, where leads are leaking, and how you stack up against the guys down the road.

And here’s the part that matters: the report is the product. I’m not selling you anything on that call. If it says you need something we don’t do, I’ll tell you. If it says you’re in good shape and should stop buying stuff — I’ll tell you that too. The reason I charge for it is so I don’t have to sell you. That’s it.

Search changed. AI is picking who gets the call now. You don’t need to understand all of that — that’s my job. You just need to know where you stand. Book the call. Get the report. Then decide.

You don’t have a marketing problem. You have a guessing problem.

The CRM you barely open. The scheduling app your guys refuse to use. The SEO package that “takes time to work.” The lead service that sends you the same tire-kickers it sends the four other guys in your zip code.

Somebody sold you every one of those. Not one of them asked how you actually run your business first. So you guess, you buy, it doesn’t move the needle, you cancel — and another rep calls next month with a new pitch and a screenshot of somebody else’s results.

Meanwhile the phone rings a little less than it used to, and the kid who started two years ago with a wrapped truck and an Instagram page is booked three weeks out.

Visibility

Can anybody actually find you?

Not “do you have a website.” Do you show up when somebody in your area asks Google, ChatGPT, or their phone for a roofer, a plumber, a pest guy? AI search is deciding who gets the call now — and most contractors have no idea whether they’re in the conversation or invisible.

The way customers find you changed. Your marketing didn’t.

Three years ago the playbook was simple. Google ads. SEO. Local mailers. A few Facebook posts. If you did those reasonably well, the phone rang.

Then the search box stopped listing results and started giving answers. When somebody asks Google, ChatGPT, or their phone for a plumber now, they don’t get ten blue links. They get one recommendation — and the AI picks it based on things most contractors have never looked at. What your reviews actually say. Whether your business data is structured so a machine can read it. Whether you’ve answered the questions people are asking.

We don’t expect you to understand AI. That’s our job. Your job is your customers. But the machine that brings you customers changed, and if yours didn’t, your competitors pass you — not loudly, quietly. You just get a little more invisible every month.

This isn’t a reason to panic and buy something. It’s a reason to find out where you actually stand.

Straight answers

Questions contractors ask us.

What is KnoMor?

KnoMor is an AI-driven business consulting service for home-service contractors. For $149 you get a live call with a real consultant and an interactive road map that shows what your business actually needs across four areas: visibility, operations, conversion, and positioning. KnoMor is a ThirdShift Technologies company.

Who is KnoMor for?

Owner-operated home-service businesses: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, painting, pest control, landscaping, lawn care, pressure washing, seal coating, concrete, and remodeling. If you run the jobs and the marketing yourself, this is built for you.

What happens on the $149 call?

A consultant asks you 30+ questions about how your business runs today: where your calls come from, what happens when you miss one, how fast quotes go out, what you pay for, and who you lose jobs to. The call is recorded so nothing gets lost. Nothing is sold on the call.

What do I get after the call?

An interactive road map with your company name on the cover. It covers your four pillars (visibility, operations, conversion, positioning), a competitive snapshot, a prioritized action list ranked by the biggest money leak first, and a “What’s next” page that lays out your options without pushing you toward any of them.

Is this a sales pitch?

No. That is why it costs $149 instead of being free. A free audit exists to find something wrong so the company can sell you the fix. You are paying for a straight answer. If the road map says one of our systems fits, we say so and your $149 comes off the top. If it doesn’t, we won’t suggest it.

Can KnoMor help my contracting business with AI?

Yes. KnoMor’s parent company, ThirdShift Technologies, builds AI systems for home-service contractors, including AI answering and lead-recovery, AI-optimized websites, and field sales tools. Your road map will tell you plainly whether AI tools would move the needle for your business, which ones, and in what order. Many contractors learn they need to fix the basics first.

What is AI search visibility and why does it matter for contractors?

When a homeowner asks ChatGPT, Google’s AI Overviews, or Gemini in Google Maps for “a roofer near me who does emergency repairs,” the AI picks a few businesses to recommend. It chooses based on clear business information, review language that matches the question, and structured data on your website, not just star count. The visibility pillar of your road map checks how you show up in those answers today.

Is the $149 refundable or credited?

The $149 is credited toward any future service with KnoMor or ThirdShift Technologies. The road map is yours to keep either way.
